Name: Fish Tank Capacity
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This is a simple mod that lets you put as much stuff in fish tanks, aquariams, etc. as you like.

By default, it removes all limits (technically sets the limit of each category to 2,147,483,647), but you can set limit multipliers or set custom limits in the config.

The mod also lets you add items not normally allowed in fish tanks as decorations by holding down the modifier key (default [b]Left Shift[/b]) while adding the item.

Note that fish tanks have a limited number of decoration slots, so there is a maximum to the number of decorations displayed at one time.

Also check out [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/56087]Fish Tank Wallpaper[/url][/b] for adding wallpaper to fish tanks.

[u][b][size=5]Custom Decoration Display[/size][/b][/u]

Modders can cause specific objects to display differently from their ordinary appearance, similar to the modified appearances of ordinary fish tank decorations, using Content Patcher, e.g.:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.9.0",
    "Changes": [
{
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.SeaweedDecorationCP/seaweed",
            "FromFile": "assets/seaweed.png",
},
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.FishTankCapacity/dict",
            "Entries": {
                "152": [
                    {
                        "Texture": "aedenthorn.SeaweedDecorationCP/seaweed",
                        "SourceRect": {
                            "X": 0,
                            "Y": 0,
                            "Width": 16,
                            "Height": 16
                        },
                        "Frames": 4,
                        "FrameRate": 120,
                        "Scale": 4
                    }
                ]
            }
        }
    ]
}[/code]
This causes seaweed to display using a custom animated sprite when placed in a fish tank. I've included a pack using the above code in the optional files if you want to use it as a template. 

Frames and FrameRate should be omitted for non-animated decorations. Frames are taken from the source texture in horizontal order. FrameRate is the number of ticks per frame.

Note that the dictionary value is an array, so you can include multiple entries and the mod will choose one at random, similar to how seaweed ordinarily has a random appearance taken from three different sprites.

The above method works for items not ordinarily placeable in fish tanks as well.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
